snippet.title: ALATURKA - Vision Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist ALATURKA on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4226560?utm_source=bufuakgames&utm_medium=youtube&utm_campaign=steampagereveal

Do you miss the times when games looked like this?
The old days when they challenged us... when it was all about pure fun?

Hi, I'm Burak.

I miss those days too. That’s why, for the past year, I've been building a world from scratch, entirely on live streams, with the support of my small community.

It's called ALATURKA.
Set in 70s Bosforus, where the radio plays psychedelic Anatolian tunes and the cars are heavy and bulky.

It’s a chaotic open-world where you hustle for every Lira, drift through narrow streets... and maybe beat up that annoying ice cream man.

I'm developing ALATURKA as a solo and it's still in early stages. It has bugs, glitches, and rough edges.

But I’m not building this behind closed doors. I’m making it entirely on livestreams, with your feedback, since day one.

If you want to be part of this nostalgic journey...Add it to your Wishlist on Steam.
